## Supplied inputs and checked prerequisites

The helpers below are provided so this lab runs independently. Inspect their
contracts, then use them without changing their missing-value behavior.

```{r}
markers <- data.frame(
  marker_a = c(4.1, 5.2, NA, 6.0),
  marker_b = c(12, 10, 9, 11),
  marker_c = rep(NA_real_, 4)
)

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  if (!is.numeric(x) || !is.null(dim(x))) {
    stop("x must be a numeric vector", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (any(is.infinite(x))) {
    stop("x must not contain infinite values", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
  mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

classify_change <- function(change) {
  stopifnot(is.numeric(change), is.null(dim(change)))
  out <- rep("missing", length(change))
  observed <- !is.na(change)
  out[observed & change < 0] <- "decrease"
  out[observed & change >= 0] <- "no decrease"
  out
}

change_summary <- function(baseline, followup) {
  stopifnot(is.numeric(baseline), is.null(dim(baseline)),
            is.numeric(followup), is.null(dim(followup)),
            length(baseline) == length(followup),
            !any(is.infinite(baseline)), !any(is.infinite(followup)))
  change <- followup - baseline
  data.frame(change = change, category = classify_change(change))
}
baseline_columns <- list(marker_a = c(10, 8, NA, 12), marker_b = c(4, 6, 8, NA))
followup_columns <- list(marker_a = c(8, 9, 7, 12), marker_b = c(5, 4, 8, 9))
row_input <- matrix(seq_len(24) / 10, nrow = 6)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(safe_mean(markers$marker_a), 5.1)),
          identical(safe_mean(markers$marker_c), NA_real_))
```

## 7. Verify and measure

```{r}
growing <- function(x) {
  out <- numeric(0)
  for (i in seq_along(x)) out <- c(out, sqrt(x[i]))
  out
}
preallocated <- function(x) {
  out <- numeric(length(x))
  for (i in seq_along(x)) out[i] <- sqrt(x[i])
  out
}
```
